import sys
from yt_dlp.utils.traversal import traverse_obj

DATA = {
    'L1': [
        {'L2a': [{'k': 1}, {'k': 2}]},
        {'L2b': {'L3': [{'k': 3}]}}
    ]
}
PATH = ('L1', ..., (('L2a', ..., 'k'), ('L2b', 'L3', ..., 'k')))

max_depth = 0
depth = 0
prefix = '/testbed/yt_dlp/'

def tracer(frame, event, arg):
    global depth, max_depth
    fn = frame.f_code.co_filename
    name = frame.f_code.co_name
    if fn.startswith(prefix) and name != '<genexpr>':
        if event == 'call':
            depth += 1
            if depth > max_depth:
                max_depth = depth
        elif event in ('return', 'exception'):
            depth -= 1
    return tracer

sys.settrace(tracer)
res = traverse_obj(DATA, PATH)
sys.settrace(None)
print('result', res)
print('max_depth', max_depth)
print('final_depth', depth)
PY
